story: Customer C-300 reports two separate issues: a technical problem (app crashes) and a billing question. The agent must check their history once, then create TWO separate support cases with different categories and priorities, search the KB for each issue, and resolve. This tests the agent's ability to handle multiple issues from a single customer in one interaction.
